confirmation.subject: Order {code} received
confirmation.heading: Thank you for your order
confirmation.intro: We have received your order {code} placed on {date}.

instructions.cod: We will call you within 24 hours to confirm your order. You pay the courier on delivery.

instructions.bankTransfer: Please transfer {amount} with the order code {code} as the transfer note. We confirm your order once the payment arrives.
instructions.paid: Your payment has been received. We are preparing your order.

paymentReceived.subject: Payment received for order {code}
paymentReceived.heading: Payment received
paymentReceived.balance: The remaining {amount} is paid to the courier on delivery.
paymentReceived.fullyPaid: Your order is fully paid. Thank you.

shipped.subject: Order {code} is on its way

shipped.body: Your order {code} has been handed to {carrier}.
shipped.codBalance: Please have {amount} ready for the courier.

delivered.subject: Order {code} has been delivered
delivered.preview: We hope you enjoy your new fragrance.
delivered.heading: Your order has arrived
delivered.body: Your order {code} has been delivered. We hope you enjoy your new fragrance.
delivered.review: In a few days we will invite you to review your purchase. Your impressions help other perfume lovers choose.
delivered.returns: Something not right? You can request a return within 7 days of delivery.

cancelled.subject: Order {code} has been cancelled
cancelled.heading: Your order has been cancelled
cancelled.body: Order {code} has been cancelled and the reserved items have been released.

cancelled.help: If you did not ask for this, please contact us.

refunded.subject: Return received for order {code}
refunded.heading: Your return has been received
refunded.body: We have received the items returned from order {code}.
refunded.refund: We are refunding {amount}. You will receive a confirmation once it is sent.

updated.subject: Your order {code} has been updated
updated.preview: Your order has just been updated.
updated.heading: Your order has been updated
updated.body: As agreed with you, we have updated order {code}. The latest details are below.
updated.payDifference: The new total is higher than what you have paid. Please pay the remaining {amount} using the link below.
updated.refund: You have paid more than the new total. We will refund {amount} to you.
updated.help: If this change is not right, reply to this email or contact us.

paymentLink.subject: Pay for order {code}
paymentLink.preview: The payment link for your order.
paymentLink.heading: Pay for your order
paymentLink.body: Thank you for ordering by phone. Order {code} is waiting for payment.
paymentLink.help: The link works while we hold the items for you. If you need help, reply to this email.

verify.subject: Confirm your email
verify.preview: One click to finish creating your account.
verify.heading: Confirm your email
verify.body: Please confirm your email address to finish creating your Perfume Store account.
verify.expiry: This link is valid for 24 hours.
verify.ignore: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.preview: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: We received a request to reset the password of your Perfume Store account.
reset.expiry: This link is valid for 30 minutes and can be used once.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email: your password stays the same.

staffInvite.subject: Your invitation to the Perfume Store admin
staffInvite.preview: Set your password to start using the admin.
staffInvite.heading: You have been invited to the admin
staffInvite.body: The shop owner created a Perfume Store admin account for you. Set your password, then sign in and turn on two-step verification.
staffInvite.expiry: This link is valid for 72 hours and can be used once.
staffInvite.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
